items.text: [Ver 1.08.2 Update]
We have fixed a map generation bug that has been occurring since Ver 1.08.
[Ver 1.0.8 Update]

notes.title: The following fixes have been implemented in Ver 1.0.8

items.text: ・Fixed an issue where the Type 26 Revolver could be used to break locks without consuming ammo through specific maneuvers.
・Fixed an issue where the "Healthy Body" Karuta card was not providing protection against defilement other than rain.
We have fixed bugs caused by the ver1.17 update.
・Fixed issues related to DLC Karuta
・Fixed issues related to DLC maps
・Fixed a bug where players hiding in objects were evicted by Apparitions despite not being pursued
・Fixed the material of the Mechanical Doll’s hair
・Fixed a bug preventing the clear event in Corridor of Endless Rain from progressing
Thank you very much for always playing Shadow Corridor 2. We have updated to ver1.17. The details are as follows:
Added support for DLC
Adjusted the effects of the "Trump Card" and "Lights of Hope" Karuta
Fixed the rendering of Shigure's hair
Fixed an issue where isolated rooms could be generated
Improved controller operability
Other minor bug fixes
Fixes
・Fixed an issue where changing the interact button in the key configuration could cause the displayed button-mashing icon when the player is restrained to show an incorrect button.
・Fixed cursor issues in the Firefly Shop purchase menu when using a controller.
・Fixed an issue where Shion might not respond to firecrackers.
・Fixed an issue where being dragged out of a hiding object by a roamer could sometimes result in the cutscene not progressing and the player becoming unresponsive.
・Fixed an issue where damage could be taken during corridor generation on retry.
・Fixed a bug that occurred when skipping certain events.
・Fixed an issue where using the hourglass to reset the story could cause unintended stages to display the Story mark after clearing stages without the mark.
・Fixed an issue in the "Missing Windhole" stage where Miko's shadow would occasionally stop chasing the player.
settings in the options.
・Adjusted to recover madness gauge when restrained.
・Expanded the hitbox for Shion's head area for the Type 26 Pistol.
・Relaxed the conditions for triggering the event where the black entity approaches after clearing Rain Corridor.
・Moved the location of the water mirror in the post-clear area of Tree Sea Complex to a more noticeable spot.
Fixes
・Fixed the issue where the shadows cast by light sources became blurred after ver1.12.
・Fixed the issue where some floor materials in the Depths of Remembrance were not displaying properly after ver1.12.
・Fixed the issue where roamers could get stuck in the corners of hallways after ver1.12.
・Fixed the issue where light source load increased on some PC configurations after ver1.12.
・Fixed the behavior related to the Mizuchi's submersion and appearance.
・Fixed the issue where roamers could get stuck in the terrain when approaching from a distance.
・Fixed the issue where the shop menu remained displayed permanently after the Magatama challenge ended while shopping in Hotaruya.
・Fixed the issue where the flames of previously lit candles persisted when generating a new map.
・Fixed the issue where the lighter would flicker even when not near a roamer if lit at the moment of leaving a light source's flicker range.
・Fixed the issue where the sound effect of the sacred tree's water splash did not reflect the volume
settings in the options.
・Adjustments & Additions
・Adjusted so that stationary mechanical dolls do not spawn consecutively next to each other in the Shrine.
・Changed the activation rate of the Karuta "Recondensation" from 20% to 50%.
・Changed the activation rate of the Karuta "Recklessness" from 30% to 50%.
・Changed the health consumption of the passive item "Lizard's Tail" from 50% to 30% of the current health.
Fixes
・Fixed an issue where Mizuchi could catch the player while submerged underwater
・Fixed the unnatural darkness of the lighting in Café Dragon's Beard when starting a new game after version 1.12
・Fixed the issue where the processing load for light sources increased unnecessarily after ver1.12
・Fixed the screen effect when using the Sakurai Spear
・Improved UI navigation with controllers
・Fixed an issue where the footstep reduction effect wasn’t properly applied against Murasakion
・Fixed an issue where the second digit couldn't be set to 0 in the otherworld coordinates setting of custom games
Adjustments and Additions
・Added shadow rendering level to the options menu
・Adjusted the range of audible footsteps based on difficulty levels
・Added a description for the "Ninja" card
・Adjusted Murasakion's alert state so it now deactivates over time if no footsteps are detected within its detection range
・Improved UI operations when using a controller
・Fixed an issue where isolated areas could be generated
・Fixed the behavior related to Mizuchi’s lurking and appearance
・Fixed an issue where Miko's shadow sometimes wouldn’t follow in the Lost Windhole
・Fixed an issue where coming out of a hiding object and immediately hiding again could make controls unresponsive
・Fixed an issue where entering a hiding object in front of a Wanderer could cause the Wanderer to stop moving
・Fixed an issue where if the player is pulled out of a hiding object by a Wanderer and hides again, the Wanderer would stop moving
・Fixed an issue where the Magatama Challenge trophy might not display correctly
・Fixed an issue in the Magatama Challenge where the effect range of obstacles and visual effect range were inconsistent in the Glass Pavilion and the Jukai Housing Complex
・Fixed an issue where certain areas in "The Bottom of Reminiscence" did not appear on the minimap
・Fixed an issue where screen effects would be disabled when opening the options menu while using the Star Hourglass and Senrimaru
・Fixed an issue where the soul was consumed after map generation when equipping the "Otherworld Map" gear
・Fixed an issue where souls would continue to be consumed during map generation after reaching the goal in Marathon mode while equipping the "Otherworld Map" gear
・Fixed an issue where controllers would still vibrate even when the vibration option was turned off
・Fixed an issue where health was not carried over when resuming paused data from a Marathon with the "Shura's Shackles" equipped
・Fixed an issue where Carta effects from carried items would activate when resuming paused data in a Marathon
・Fixed an issue where the coffee effect was not saved in Marathon paused data
・Fixed an issue where Custom Game Slot 3 was not displayed correctly
・Fixed an issue with skipping some cutscenes
・Fixed an issue where player input was still accepted during cutscenes
・Fixed an issue where Shura Medals and Great Cremation Medals were not properly added to the total score
・Fixed an issue where no information was displayed when purchasing a light source item in Hotaruya if there were no empty light source slots available
・Due to wanderers sometimes being unable to pass through the stairs of Jukai Housing Complex, the structure of the stairs has been modified for correction
Adjustments & Additions
・Adjust the warning when deleting save data to make it visually clearer
・Adjust map generation so that pests and obstacles do not appear near the start and goal points
・Added a zoom-in feature for Karuta descriptions
・Added corridor BGM, flashlight shake, whispering of the remains, and FPS limit to the options menu
・Made the visual indication of collected spirit remains clearer
・Changed the ending illustrations
・Added new illustrations to the gallery
・Reduced the spirit consumption of Karuta "Doll Summon" from 2500 to 800
・Reduced the magatama cost of Karuta "Amaterasu" from 30 to 15
・Adjusted the effect of Karuta "Sound of Exorcism" so that wanderers flee radially around firecrackers
・Revised the description of Karuta "Ninja" to make it easier to understand
・Slightly reduced the chase speed when Mizuchi is detected
・Adjusted the timing of mechanical dolls' appearance when obtaining magatama while using the star hourglass in the shrine
・Reduced the number of mechanical dolls that appear when obtaining magatama from Flower Rot in the shrine, matching the number on higher difficulty
・Reduced processing load for distant wanderers
Fixed an issue where a special clear mark might not be obtained when clearing a marathon.
Corrected the boss damage detection in the latter half of the Divine Tree.
Fixed a bug related to the item inventory of passive items.
Fixed an issue where the effect persisted after removing a carta from the option carta slot.
Fixed a problem where the behavior of the carta slot became erratic when the option carta slot was sealed.
Fixed an issue where walls could generate in the corridors between sections.
Fixed the issue where wanderers do not come to check the location after sensing the player's footsteps.
Fixed the destruction of the entire classroom or candy store when dragged out from hiding objects within them.
Fixed the issue where red glass sometimes appears in the clear goal areas and galleries of the Glass Pavilion.
Adjusted the requirements for acquiring the Heart of Darkness medal.
Fixed the issue where the healing barrier spell continues outside of the barrier.
Made it so that Mr. Dandy cannot be used inside galleries or hiding objects.
Fixed camera shaking during teleportation.
Fixed the issue where wandering purple grudges do not respond to firecrackers while sensing footsteps.
Fixed the issue where some medals appeared in the archive before being acquired.
Fixed the display of an A rank when no medals had been earned.
Modified so that Karuta fighters cannot be sealed.
Adjusted the display of some exhibits in the gallery.
Fixed an issue where the game would freeze upon completing a marathon, which started occurring from ver1.09.
Fixed an issue where the game freezes after clearing the temple and marathon, which started occurring from ver1.09.
・Fixed an issue where Carta Physical Language would not be released.
・Fixed Carta Amaterasu consuming more than 30 magatama.
・Fixed the effect of Carta Idaten continuing even after being removed from the Carta slot.
・Fixed Carta Unasu's Secret not having an effect.
・Fixed wanderers not disappearing immediately upon clearing a stage.
・Fixed Filthy People repeatedly warping.
・Fixed Mechanical Dolls not wandering when spawned.
・Fixed some achievements not being unlocked.
・Fixed Traumas not approaching the player in certain cases.
・Fixed wanderers stopping in place if they cannot reach the location of a sound they heard.
・Fixed wanderers leaving the barrier when the distance from the wanderer inside the barrier becomes too great.
・Fixed being unable to escape from restraints after teleporting while restrained.
・Fixed passive items not having an effect when resuming from marathon interruption data.
・Fixed health and maximum health being carried over when resuming from marathon interruption data.
・Fixed Carta Otherworldly Friend having an effect even if not set upon resuming from marathon interruption data.
・Fixed an issue where traumas do not appear.
・Fixed an issue where Mayubou does not chase.
・Fixed an issue where fixed-type Shion moves.
・Fixed an issue where wanderers get stuck in walls and other obstacles.
・Fixed an issue so that wanderers properly roam the entire map.
・Fixed an issue where Amaterasu is not correctly applied when dying from corruption.
・Fixed some localizations.
・Fixed an issue where a special Karuta's stage clear mark was not being saved correctly.
・Fixed trauma not reviving outside the stage you're currently playing.
・Fixed so that if time was stopped when obtaining a Magatama in the shrine, mechanical dolls will spawn after time starts moving again.
・Fixed an issue where the flashlight would not turn off under certain operations.
・Fixed rain sections and items not being set properly in custom games.
・Fixed the time stop sound effect continuing even after being lifted.
・Fixed a bug where the effects of a passive item dropped by the Twin Insertion would persist after the item was dropped.
・Fixed sometimes there are wanderers that do not appear in the Clairvoyance.
・Fixed the Divine Tree's rain not being depicted.
・Slightly slowed down the trauma door destruction speed.
・Expanded the purification area in the firefly hut's bottom of Remembrance.
・Changed the glowing butterfly lanterns to not consume souls near the firefly hut.
・Added arrows to dropped items to improve visibility.
・Displayed a guide on the first utility pole in Hydrangea Alley.
Corrections
・Fixed an issue where the pause menu could not be opened during the Magatama Challenge.
・Fixed an issue where the story clear status was not properly saved when clearing with a powerful Karuta.
・Fixed an issue to ensure the correct acquisition of reward Karuta in Marathon Mode.
・Fixed an issue where becoming hidden in an object at the same time as teleporting would make it unresponsive to controls.
・Fixed an issue where dying under the area effect of the Glass Tower would leave the screen blacked out.
・Corrected the display of the option Karuta slot when using the Karuta deck during a stage.
・When using the Karuta deck during a stage, fixed to not display Karuta already set in the Karuta slot.
・Fixed an issue where pressing the 1 key changes the stamina recovery speed.
・Fixed an issue where some achievements were not unlocked.
Adjustments
・Optimized the processing of distant wanderers.
・Changed the appearance of the decaying flower Magatama to green when viewed with Clairvoyance.
correction
・Fixed an issue where some archives were always displayed in Japanese.
・Fixed so that the bronze hand mirror cannot be used in the missing wind cave and event area.
・Fixed an issue where trauma remained in the game even after finishing the stage.
・Fixed a rare issue where the drawer would get stuck in collision detection.
・Fixed an issue where the optional environmental sound was not applied to the waterfall sound.
・Fixed an issue where if you hide inside an object at the moment you go crazy, you will not be able to release the madness.
・Fixed the issue where destroyed doors would remain in the game.
・Fixed an issue where slapstick medals were not added to the clear result score.
・Fixed the issue where slapstick medals were not displayed in the archive.
・Fixed an issue where if you died while looking back, you would remain in that state even after being revived.
・Fixed an issue where walls could be destroyed when a wanderer kicked them out of an object.
・Fixed an issue where the compass would continue to malfunction after playing Jukai Danchi.
・Corrected the description of the Shura medal.
・Corrected so that the clear time of Flower Rot is displayed correctly.
・Fixed so that loitering settings are applied correctly in custom games.
・Corrected so that you will not receive damage from the trap Terteru Bozu inside hidden objects.
・Fixed so that the mechanical doll does not move when time is stopped at the timing when the mechanical doll appears.
adjustment
・Adjusted the item appearance rate in Otherworldly School, Hydrangea Alley, and Jukai Housing Complex.
・Reduced the number of explosive mushrooms placed in Beginner and Intermediate level in Jukai Complex.
・Reduced the number of mechanical dolls generated in the beginner and intermediate levels of the shrine
・Changed the influence of Karuta “Two-ring Vase” on the consumable item slot from -2 to -1.
・Swaped the clear benefits for intermediate and advanced marathons.
・Increased the archive appearance rate in Karuta “Old Book Collector”
・Adjusted the volume of the trap Terteru Bozu
・Fixed a bug where the pause menu could be opened in unexpected places.
・Fixed an issue where getting thrown by wanderers onto objects could cause stacking.
・Fixed a problem where activating Hibana's charm inside a hideable object would stop accepting inputs.
・Corrected the behavior where Mizuchi drags out hiding players.
・Fixed an issue where archives of the Magatsuhi Divinity Mythology could not be acquired beyond the 16th entry.
・Modified some texts.
Fixes
・Fixed an issue where snails no longer appear on the dragon's beard.
・Fixed a rare issue where the magatama under the hole is covered by walls and cannot be collected.
・Fixed a bug with the restart point when dying under specific conditions in the Vanishing Wind Hole.
・Fixed a control issue after dying due to the area effect in the Glass Tower.
・Fixed an issue where Hotaru Ya tickets could be used on certain stages.
・Fixed a bug where the healing barrier spell does not activate on some stages.
・Fixed an issue where wanderers sometimes do not move from in front of the door.
・Fixed a bug where the mechanical doll archive does not sell out.
・Fixed an issue where the soul display is not reflected when starting a stage with the medium constitution set.
・Fixed an issue where holding the compass at the goal causes it to remain held in the area after clearing.
・Fixed a bug that allows the pause menu to be opened during corridor generation.
Adjustments
・Changed the required souls for sealing Hotaru Ya's cards from 1500 to 1000.
・Changed the required souls for the maximum health increase map gimmick from 1500 to 1000.
・Changed the required souls for obtaining the Life Candle to 1500 from 3000 in normal game mode.
・Adjusted the sealing probability of the Unclean's cards according to difficulty.
・Optimized the rain rendering in corridor stages.
・Fixed an issue where exiting the menu in the Depths of Remembrance could cause the game to become unresponsive.
・Fixed the problem where the player becomes invincible after using a specific passive item.
・As a temporary measure for the issue where CPU usage could spike abnormally, the FPS limit has been set to 60.
・Fixed an issue where obtaining the Great Cremation Medal did not reflect in the save data.
・Corrected the acquisition conditions for the Transfer Medal, which were different from the description
・Fixed an issue where closing the archive and options screen with the ESC key would not work properly.
・Fixed an issue where restarting the story from the base's hourglass would reset the save data.
